title: I built a 3D digital version of Risk: Game of Thrones
author: Heavy-Art381
selftext:
Hi everyone, I’ve been lurking here for quite a while without ever posting.

For the past few weeks I’ve been working on my second AI-made game, a digital version of Risk: Game of Thrones, so I can play with my friends remotely. So far it represents about 40 work sessions spread over almost two months. Every asset was produced and refined with Claude, Gemini and Replicate; I didn’t use any other software. If you’re interested, I’m happy to go into detail about my exact workflow.

I still have a whole round of testing, improvements and polish ahead before I can make it available. For now only the solo mode is built; multiplayer is my next big project.

I have no financial ambitions for this game: I obviously don’t have the rights, so my goal is simply to make it available for free, for me and my friends. But I figure it could also interest fans who have been waiting a long time for a proper adaptation of the board game.

Do you think I could run into legal trouble by doing this?

comments.author: Agile_Branch_8743
comments.body: You cannot use any copyrighted IP without explicit permission from the IP owner. It doesn't matter if the project is free or not. In terms of legal trouble, best case they will not even realize this exists, otherwise I guess worst case they'll ask you to take it down. In theory they could ask for compensation, etc., but it's usually not the case.

replies.author: Heavy-Art381
replies.body: Thanks for the feedback! There’s definitely some risk there, which will probably make me keep the game just for my friends and me.
